findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML parsing in BeautifulSoup
 * @description Identify XML parsing calls in BeautifulSoup
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/xml-parsing
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // BeautifulSoup constructor calls
  call = API::moduleImport("bs4").getMember("BeautifulSoup").getACall() or
  // lxml parsing
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring"]).getACall() or
  // xml.etree parsing
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring"]).getACall() or
  // xml.dom parsing
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall() or
  // xml.sax parsing
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall()
select call, "XML parsing call that may be vulnerable to XXE if not configured securely"
findings.hypothesis: BeautifulSoup may use unsafe XML parsers that could be vulnerable to XXE attacks
